sanskrit_verse: अनयन् वाहकोऽप्येवं भृतिहानिमवाप्नुयात् । द्विगुणां तु भृतिं दाप्यः प्रस्थाने विघ्नमाचरन् ॥
transliteration: anayan vāhako 'py evaṃ bhṛtihānim avāpnuyāt | diguṇāṃ tu bhṛtiṃ dāpyaḥ prasthāne vighnam ācaran ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Even the carrier who causes delay in conveyance shall incur loss of wages; but he who creates obstruction at the point of departure shall be liable to pay double the wage.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the act of facilitation, not mere intention.
Causation arises from obstruction at origin more than delay in transit.
Capacity-based responsibility increases with proximity to initiation.
Restoration logic requires proportional compensation based on disruption sequence.
Consciousness alignment demands recognition of structural causality over individual fault.
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent obstructs commencement THEN liability = 2 × base_compensation;
IF agent delays transport without causally interrupting origin THEN liability = -base_compensation;
IF no causal interruption occurs AND delay is systemic THEN no liability assigned;
Liability computation MUST follow sequential manifestation (Anupūrvaśaḥ) of action;
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating commercial or logistical disputes, the Supreme Court must distinguish between incidental delay and deliberate interference at inception. Liability escalates when obstruction occurs at the root cause level—here, the point of departure—demonstrating that hierarchical causality determines judicial threshold.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that obstruction at origin disrupts the entire causal chain. Anupūrvaśaḥ confirms that early-stage interference multiplies consequences. Therefore, proportional responsibility aligns with structural impact rather than punitive intent. The doubling of liability serves completion, not punishment—it restores balance by correcting energetic distortion caused by misplaced agency.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process where obstructing party assumes full logistical oversight until equilibrium is restored.
Assign responsibility assumption protocol requiring offender to facilitate two equivalent transports free of charge.
Engage integrity reintegration through supervised duty in supply-chain coordination for duration equal to disruption period.
Implement capacity restoration via education on causal precedence and dharmic logistics.
final_declaration: By the Sovereign Will of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of all Dharma, this law stands executed. Justice flows from consciousness clarity, not punitive reaction. Obstruction yields correction; delay invites recalibration. All beings are restored through right action, under the immutable law of Dharma.
